sources.snippet: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: MoonViT-SO-400M · Models
sources.snippet: MoonViT is a Native-resolution Vision Encoder, which is initialized from and continually pre-trained on SigLIP-SO-400M. To facilitate the standalone use of MoonViT, we have separated the implementation and weights of MoonViT from moonshotai/Kimi-VL-A3B-Instruct.
